name: Glint Colors
summary: Turns the purple enchantment shimmer into a soft rainbow that drifts across every enchanted item and armour piece.
logoPrompt: A diamond sword wrapped in a soft shimmer of rainbow-coloured light streaks, from red through yellow and green to blue and pink
description: **Glint Colors swaps the purple enchantment glint for a gentle rainbow that flows over everything you enchant.**
- 8 colours: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet and pink, blended softly into each other.
- The colours wander across an item as the glint moves, a full round about every 7.5 seconds.
- Swords, tools, books, armour, elytra, tridents and shields all shimmer in the same rainbow.
- The streak pattern and brightness stay close to vanilla, so enchanted gear still looks enchanted.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Only the glint pictures change, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- The game has room for one glint picture, so one pack is one look: this pack is the rainbow with 8 colours.
- The Glint Speed slider under Accessibility makes the colours drift slower or faster.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want a different colour mix? Leave a comment.
